posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, a computer-use frontier model framed as entering the AGI era, rolling out via Daybreak then ChatGPT and the API.

posts.title: Nvidia to buy Hugging Face for $12.9B
posts.summary: Nvidia confirmed a $12.93B deal for Hugging Face; the hub stays multi-vendor and will not require Nvidia compute. Close targeted for H1 2027.

posts.title: Thinking Machines eyes $1B Accel round
posts.summary: Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab is reportedly discussing a $1B Accel-led raise at about $40B, with ARR already over $100M.

posts.title: Crusoe raises $3B at $30B
posts.summary: AI data-center builder Crusoe reportedly raised $3B at a $30B valuation after securing a $13B Jane Street contract.

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3: frontier, partly gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 ships strong coding and agent price/performance, but the top max-reasoning config is still gated pending more safety testing.

posts.title: Claude Fable 5.1 cuts cache costs 75%
posts.summary: Anthropic launched Fable/Mythos 5.1 with cache reads cut to $0.25 per million tokens and new Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

posts.title: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 at $0.10/hour
posts.summary: Microsoft AI priced MAI-Transcribe-2 at 10 cents per hour with 60 languages and diarization, undercutting OpenAI, Google, and ElevenLabs.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra enters the AGI era
posts.summary: The Verge covers Astra’s launch as a generational leap for coding and computer use, with Critical cyber safeguards after the Hugging Face incident.

posts.title: WeatherNext 3 goes hourly at 5km
posts.summary: Google DeepMind’s WeatherNext 3 delivers hourly 5km forecasts from live satellite data, with up to 60% better precipitation scores vs NASA IMERG.

posts.title: Nvidia buying Hugging Face for ~$13B
posts.summary: Nvidia agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B while promising the platform stays open to all model builders and clouds.

posts.title: Meta pays users for Muse Spark prompts
posts.summary: Meta’s Muse Spark contributor tier deep-discounts tokens if users share prompts and outputs to help train future models.

posts.title: Abliteration.ai strips model guardrails
posts.summary: Startup sells easier access to unguarded open-weight models, arguing defenders need the same tools attackers already have.

posts.title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude outage overlap
posts.summary: Three major chatbots hit overlapping outages on Sep 3; all recovered, with no confirmed shared root cause.

posts.title: Suno yanks Mary J. Blige ad
posts.summary: AI music firm Suno killed a Blige campaign after learning the deal wasn’t authorized by her real representatives.

posts.title: Claude Code 2.1.260 live diff panel
posts.summary: Anthropic’s Claude Code adds a /diff panel for uncommitted changes and fixes permission rules that broke on paths with parentheses.

posts.title: LLaDA-Image: 6B open image gen
posts.summary: Ant Group’s inclusionAI open-weights 6B image generate/edit model; a distilled Turbo checkpoint runs in 4 steps.

posts.title: Astra hits 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3 (harness)
posts.summary: ARC Prize: GPT-6 Astra scores 62.7% on the standard harness and 99.9% with a Provider Adapter harness on ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private.

posts.title: K2 Horizon: six fully open models
posts.summary: Institute of Foundation Models released six Apache-2.0 models from 0.9B to 375B with weights, training code, data mixtures, and eval logs.

posts.title: Cohere maps 696k AI tools to job tasks
posts.summary: Cohere Labs’ Agentic Task Ecosystem links 696,291 tools across 123,069 MCP servers to work tasks; only 2.6% finish a task end to end.
